providers.title: Japan court dismisses IHH subsidiary Northern TK Venture's damage claims against Daiichi Sankyo
providers.summary: “On 10 September 2026, the Court has decided that all of NTK’s claims are dismissed and NTK shall bear the costs of the litigation,” IHH informed the Malaysian stock exchange.
providers.thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.

diagnostics.title: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 30% in 2 days, jump 80% since debut. What lies ahead?
diagnostics.summary: The stock has now climbed around 80% from its IPO price of Rs 810, after making a strong market debut in August with a 21% premium at Rs 980.
diagnostics.thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
